title: Build HTTP client with retry in Go — 3 turns
description: Build an HTTP client with configurable retry: basic retry turn 1, exponential backoff turn 2, context cancellation turn 3.

task_spec.prompt: Implement `Get(ctx, url)` in `client/client.go` with basic retry: loop up to `c.cfg.MaxRetries+1` attempts total, retry if response status >= 500 or there's a network error. For now, use `time.Sleep(0)` between retries (no backoff). Return the last response/error. Run `go test ./...`.
followup_prompts: Good. Now add exponential backoff: between retries, sleep `currentWait` seconds, then multiply by `c.cfg.BackoffMult`. Start at `c.cfg.InitialWait`. Run `go test ./...` and fix any failures.

Run `go test ./...` to verify everything including context cancellation. Before sleeping, check if `ctx.Err() != nil` and return immediately if the context is done. Fix any failures and confirm all 4 tests pass.
success_criteria: Successful first response returned without retry
5xx responses trigger retry up to MaxRetries times
Exhausted retries returns the last response
